LOOK │Members of the urban poor group KADAMAY staged a protest at the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) Central Office in Batasan, Quezon City, on Monday, Dec. 22, 2025, calling for immediate aid and accountability. Five months after Typhoons Crising, Dante, and Emong, along with successive Habagat floods, disaster survivors demanded ₱25,000 in compensation per affected household; justice for lost homes and livelihoods; an end to corruption in flood control projects; and climate justice - including a halt to mining, quarrying, and reclamation activities blamed for worsening floods and community displacement.  

📸: Edd Castro

LOOK: Residents fire a bamboo cannon in Panabo City, Davao del Norte, over the weekend.

Locally known as “lantaka,” the gas-fueled cannon has been part of Filipino tradition during the Christmas season, leading up to New Year’s Eve celebrations as an alternative to firecrackers.

📷: Keith Bacongco | MB

On behalf of Yoko Apasra, Yoster Philippines extends our deepest and most heartfelt gratitude to everyone who donated, supported, and believed in our “Pasko ng Pag-asa  for Cebu” Christmas gift drive last Dec. 20 in Barangay Lawaan 3 Cebu City✨🎁

Although our team was unable to personally reach the area, we entrusted the distribution to a reliable individual to ensure that your generosity reached those who needed it most. During the time of giving, an unexpected fire broke out in a nearby barangay, requiring the distribution to be carried out swiftly to prioritize everyone’s safety. ❤️‍🩹

Despite the challenges, your kindness shone through. Your support became hope, comfort, and reassurance for the community during a difficult moment. We are truly humbled and grateful for the trust you placed in us.  💐

From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for being part of this mission of hope. 💖

#YokoApasra
